value.title: Fix test order dependency in class `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest`
value.body:
**Description**
All tests in `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest.java` may fail if running by their own, or more generally, running at any time before running the test class in `ArchivaRepositoryRegistry.java`.

**Reason**
In `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest`, there is a `@AfterEach` routine that calls `removeRepository()`. The call will then invoke `getRepository()`_(line 755 in `ArchivaRepositoryRegistry.java`)_. In `getRepository()`, `hasRepository()` is called on `managedRepositoryHandler` and `remoteRepositoryHandler`_(line 394 and 399 in `ArchivaRepositoryRegistry.java`)_. The two handlers are injected in `ArchivaRepositoryRegistry.java`, but not in `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest.java`. Hence, if we run tests in `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest.java` individually or any time before execution of `ArchivaRepositoryRegistry.java`, we will get a `NullPointerException`, since the two handlers have not been initialized.

**Proposed Fixes**
Using `@Inject` to properly construct `managedRepositoryHandler` and `remoteRepositoryHandler` in `BasicManagedRepositoryValidatorTest.java`, so that the test class is not dependent on test execution orders.
